Kinetic Lore V: Passive: Your Force, Physical and Untyped spells gain a 15% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Sonic Lore V: Passive: Your Sonic spells gain a 15% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Insightful Potency +5: Passive: +5 Insight bonus to each Spell Power.
